statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); style=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.output_style.name // empty'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); effort=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0'); branch=$(git -C "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // "."')" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); parts=''; if [ -n "$cwd" ] && [ -n "$branch" ]; then parts="$cwd [$branch]"; elif [ -n "$cwd" ]; then parts="$cwd"; fi; if [ -n "$style" ]; then parts="$parts | $style"; fi; if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then parts="$parts | ${ctx}% ctx left"; fi; mshort=$(echo "$model" | awk '{s=tolower(substr($1,1,1)); for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) s=s $i; print s}'); case "$effort" in low) es=l;; medium) es=m;; high) es=h;; xhigh) es=xh;; max) es=max;; ultra*) es=ultra;; *) es="$effort";; esac; if [ -n "$mshort" ]; then seg="$mshort"; [ -n "$es" ] && seg="$seg/$es"; parts="$parts | $seg"; fi; cost_fmt=$(printf "$%.2f" "$cost"); parts="$parts | $cost_fmt"; echo "$parts"
